vendor/lrc-parser.js is @lrc-maker/lrc-parser@0.1.17 UMD (MIT).
The GifOS UI is a classic wrap of magic-akari/lrc-maker's loop (load
audio, stamp lines, export LRC). The React + wavesurfer app is not packed.
